9z.zh: T 方最常用 A小跳警家烟、A坡火和鹅位火爆弹 A 点，5 次赢下 4 次。CT 及时回防占 62%，高于其他队伍的 38%。
9z.en: The T side favors an A execute with A short drop smoke, an A ramp molotov and a Goose molotov, winning 4 of 5 attempts. The CT side rotates in time in 62% of rounds versus the other teams' 38%.

aurora.zh: Aurora 的 T 方最常用 B 点爆弹，以B门烟配合，4 次进攻赢下 3 次。最常由 MAJ3R 摸边，5 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
aurora.en: Aurora's T side favors a B execute with B doors smoke, winning 3 of 4 attempts. The usual lurker is MAJ3R, with him on the other side or away from the hit on 5 attacks.

b8.zh: T 方快攻占 17%，高于其他队伍的 7%，更常以快节奏发起进攻。
b8.en: The T side fast-hits in 17% of rounds versus the other teams' 7%, attacking at a quick pace more often.

bcg.zh: BCG 的 CT 默认站位 A3 B2 占 29% 的枪局，胜率 40%。
bcg.en: BCG's default CT setup A3 B2 covers 29% of gun rounds with a 40% win rate.

betboom.zh: BETBOOM 的 T 方最常由 FL4MUS 摸边，6 次进攻时在另一侧或远离进攻点。CT 及时回防占 63%，高于其他队伍的 38%。

fut-esports.en: FUT Esports' CT side pushes early in just 16% of rounds versus the other teams' 39%, taking a forward defensive posture less often.

heroic.en: Heroic's T side fast-hits in 20% of rounds versus the other teams' 7%, while fakes before the hit account for 40% versus their 18%. Its default CT setup A2 B2 C1 covers 25% of gun rounds with a 75% win rate.
